candidates.change_summary: Change the returned boolean from true to false so transfer always returns false after performing calls.
Return the result of the last low-level call instead of always true, changing the observable boolean based on call success.
Return false immediately if any call fails; previously always returned true regardless of call results.
Insert a conditional that returns false immediately when _tos.length == 1, changing return for single-recipient calls.
Replace caddress.call(...) with require(caddress.call(...)) so that failing delegate call reverts instead of being ignored, changing observable outcomes.
Replace caddress.call(...) with (bool success, ) = caddress.call(...); require(!success) to invert success handling so a successful call causes revert, altering observable behavior.
Insert a revert when caddress is zero address so transfers to address(0) revert instead of being attempted, changing observable behavior.
Replace for loop iteration order to iterate in reverse, changing the sequence of calls and thus observable effects when order matters.
